g.text: The lane checks the deadline at dequeue, before it does any work
lane L, one packet (01 §14.1, §14.2) · 980 = LAT_MAX_NS − DEADLINE_GUARD_NS
480 ns BUSY path: any older and not even
header: session · bound address · epoch16 · pkt_seq · tag_seq
pre-encode PacketRecord → R_pkt[l] (before any push or counter release, ARC-D3)
for i in 0..count, in index order: parse · risk and reservation · classify vs snapshot
push to the BBO ring NOW
with the in-packet dependency list and
join | cancel | reduce | the cancel part of a replace
each staged op in index order: apply · counter.store(Release) after each op
when LaneCut[l] covers the op (ARC-D5, poll 20),
fill ring drained ≤ s − 1, released ≥ s:
Ack / CancelAck / Reject, built and tagged with K_out,
CTPIO on the lane's own VI
